verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Internal Agent is a built-in AI assistant you delegate configuration and operational tasks to via natural language (docs-1), which can act autonomously per auto-approve settings (docs-8, docs-14), run on schedules/triggers (docs-5), and proactively surface gaps (docs-17), with the agent also bootstrapping itself from historical tickets (docs-19). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of delegating tasks and outcomes, and more detail on the breadth/limits of what can be delegated beyond configuration and support workflows.
